snippet.title: Rikogol — Gameplay Trailer (online football, 1v1 to 11v11)
snippet.description:
Arcade football with real physics, online with your friends. Out now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4492690/Rikogol/
https://rikogol.com/

Rikogol — arcade football with real physics, online with your friends. From 1v1 duels to 11v11 derbies with a Head Coach on each side. Two controls, zero stats, no fouls, no offside — just skill. Invite through Steam and you are on the pitch in seconds. Friends offline? Take on bots at three levels.
